items.name: ui-theme
items.title: Motion UI theme
items.description: Shared motion tokens (springs, durations, easings, stagger, travel) every Motion UI section consumes. Installed automatically as a dependency of any section.

items.name: motion-theme
items.title: Motion theme config
items.description: Project-owned motion.theme.ts starter. Install once, then customise without later Motion UI installs replacing it.

items.name: velocity-preview-theme
items.title: Velocity preview theme
items.description: The optional motion.dev-brand preview theme (shadcn variable values + the light/dark switcher shell) every Motion UI section's live demo wraps in. Install it to get the monochrome Velocity look; skip it to use your own shadcn theme instead.

items.name: add-to-basket

items.name: arrow-link

items.name: border-beam
